response.sql:
WITH group_averages AS (
    SELECT
        p.death_country,
        AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points_won
    FROM player_award_vote AS v
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id
    GROUP BY p.death_country
)
SELECT
    death_country,
    avg_points_won,
    avg_points_won - AVG(avg_points_won) OVER () AS difference_from_average_of_group_averages
FROM group_averages;

assumptions.assumption: A blank death country is represented by NULL or an empty string; SQL groups each value separately, and AVG ignores missing points_won values.
